info.title: PaceStreak API
info.description: The API behind app.pacestreak.com. Generated from the router by scripts/openapi.ts; do not edit by hand.

get.summary: Liveness touches nothing, D1 included: a slow database must not make the API look dead.
slowapi ran after the dependencies, so only signed-in calls count toward the 30 a minute.

post.summary: RFC 8058: the mail client POSTs `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` with the parameters in the URL. The body carries nothing we need, so it is not read.

bearerAuth.description: The access token from sign-in or refresh, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshCookie.name: __Secure-refresh_token
refreshCookie.description: The session (refresh) cookie, `Domain=pacestreak.com`, `Path=/v1/auth`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax. Routes that rotate or end it also need `X-CSRF-Token` equal to the `__Secure-csrf_token` cookie.

Error.description: The error envelope (src/lib/errors.ts). `detail` is usually a string.

IpRateLimited.description: slowapi's per-IP body, e.g. `Rate limit exceeded: 10 per 1 minute`, with `Retry-After`.

Forbidden.description: Not allowed (including a missing or wrong CSRF token)

Conflict.description: Conflict, including a write that raced another

RateLimited.description: Too many requests: the per-user bucket (`detail`) or the per-IP limit (`error`)
